propositions: The mcp delta gate in autodeploy.sh consults MCP_PATHS but omits SECRETS_PATHS, so a commit touching only fetch-secrets.sh or ssm.tf does not trigger an mcp redeploy.
When only SECRETS_PATHS files change, the on-disk .env and mcp-static-tokens.json are refreshed but no new mcp container starts, so the running server continues using stale environment values.
The review-bot gate already ORs SECRETS_PATHS into its delta check (from incident f600/2731 fix), but the mcp gate never received the same treatment despite mcp also consuming fetch-secrets output.
mcp reads .env and mcp-static-tokens.json once at container init via --env-file and read-only bind-mount, so a running container cannot pick up refreshed values without a restart.
A pure SSM value rotation that touches no git path is out of scope for any git-delta gate and requires operator action via runbook.
